verdict.rationale: HMRC's guidance pages state some prerequisite account steps up front. These include registering with Companies House, adding Corporation Tax services to the business tax account, and the MTD compatible-software check before sign-up. Nothing in the pack names the credential type or the identity-proofing and verification steps needed before filing. missing for 10: explicit published list of credential/sign-in requirements, identity-proofing/ID-verification steps stated before starting, a single end-to-end pre-flight checklist, independent or hands-on corroboration that nothing is discovered mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
